title: Refute v0.5.8: output stability of the v0.5 battery on 167 TESS TOIs (exploratory records)
description:
Exploratory Refute v0.5.8 records for 167 TESS Objects of Interest (TOIs). Limits label: WEAKENED; does not meet D1, D2, D4, T2a. Method status: not_validated. The outputs describe this sample only. TOI verdicts, candidate claims, dispositions and discoveries are outside the scope of the dataset.

The comparison pairs v0.5.6 search-mode outputs with TOI-seeded reruns using the same v0.5 battery. It cannot isolate the effect of the seed. Input-file identity was verified for 83 of 167 targets. Of the 15 refitted signal-to-noise ratios that differed by more than 10%, 13 were lower and two were higher. The bundled report's "More than one optimum" label denotes a predefined SNR threshold and should be read as a descriptive count. See the first correction and the second correction.

CC BY 4.0 applies to Refute's original dataset content, the bundled scripts are licensed under Apache-2.0 (the LICENSE file is included), and third-party catalog values retain their source terms and applicable acknowledgment and citation requirements.

The nine data and script files are byte-identical to their counterparts in the repository snapshot at bbfdecc6eac3dfbd3e532cf83cbb006d22c136e5. See MANIFEST-sha256.json for file hashes and repository paths. The records include MAST file manifests. The TESS light curves and pixel files are not included; they are available from MAST at STScI.
